newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes shade firmer against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes shade firmer against dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint followed the dollar/mark cross on Friday, closing slightly firmer against the dollar at 175.78/83 in very light trade.
"Trade was extremely light today as we follwed a steady dollar/mark cross," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.

The forint, which floats within the central bank's 4.5-percent intervention band against a basket of currencies made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar, opened at 175.90/176.00 against the U.S. unit.
Gere added the forint was keeping its 50 filler gap from the central bank resistance level (bid), suggesting no new domestic factors affected trade.
"Fifty fillers is not a signifcant margin," he said. "It's still only 10 percent into the intervention band."
The central bank bid stood at around 175.25 at the close, Gere added.
Th National Bank midday fix, based on the average of the ten most active commercial bank quotes, stood at 175.77.
